item.title: DeLand · 2026-10-19 · City Commission Regular Meeting (City Commission): Consideration re: Second Reading of Ordinance 2026-27, Repealing the Downtown Fair Share Agreement
item.description: The recently revised utility connection fee ordinance was based upon a recent rate study. The methodology used in the study incorporated the utility improvements associated with the downtown area, which improvements are the basis of collecting a downtown fair share payment from developers in the downtown area. With the new connection fees, the costs of those improvements are included with all other city wide capital improvements. The City cannot, therefore, continue to collect the separate downtown fair share payments. This ordinance repeals the ordinance that created the downtown fair share payment. First reading of this ordinance was approved by City Commission on October 5, 2026.

item.description: The proposed Fire Station 84 will be located at the intersection of East New York Avenue and Miller Road on property currently being acquired by the City for $147,000. This location was identified through the Fire Department's predictive analytics and response modeling software as a critical area with existing emergency service coverage gaps. The selected site represents the optimal location to improve response times and enhance emergency service delivery to residents and visitors within this growing section of the City. item.title: DeLand · 2026-07-20 · City Commission Regular Meeting (City Commission): Approval of Resolution 2026-35: Approving the Proposed Millage Rate for Fiscal Year 2026-2027.
item.description: The certification of property tax values by the Volusia County Property Appraiser on July 1st provides a taxable value of $4,118,458,981, of which $170,666,818 is considered taxable new construction and annexation values. This represents an approximate 7.18% increase from the final taxable value from the prior year. The rolled-back rate is the rate that produces the same amount of revenue as received in the current fiscal year. The estimated rolled-back rate for the tax year 2026 is 6.0217 mills.
